schoolPm.title: School Project Management System
schoolPm.description: School project management system for PPLG — tracking tasks, deadlines, and team collaboration.
schoolPm.overview: The school needed a better way to manage group tasks across PPLG classes.
schoolPm.problem: Tasks and deadlines were scattered across chat groups, making it hard to track who was working on what.
schoolPm.solution: A centralized dashboard with per-class boards, member assignments, and deadline notifications.
challenges: Designing a flexible database schema for multiple classes
Maintaining performance as project data grows
schoolPm.result: Used by 3 PPLG classes to manage group tasks for the current semester.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: Personal portfolio website with an interactive guestbook powered by Supabase.
portfolio.overview: A personal portfolio to showcase projects and the learning process as a web developer.
portfolio.problem: No centralized place to showcase projects to recruiters or freelance clients.
portfolio.solution: An editorial website with a project index, journey timeline, and guestbook for visitor interaction.
challenges: Keeping the design minimal yet distinctive
Setting up secure Supabase RLS policies
portfolio.result: Portfolio ready to use for job applications and freelance projects.

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce UI Clone (Learning Project)
ecommerce.description: Simple e-commerce UI clone for learning state management and reusable components.
ecommerce.overview: A learning project to understand component-driven development patterns.
ecommerce.problem: Wanted to understand how to structure scalable e-commerce components.
ecommerce.solution: Rebuilt several core pages: product listing, product detail, and shopping cart.
challenges: Managing cart state without additional libraries
ecommerce.result: Stronger understanding of component composition and props drilling.
